Many popular accounts claim that Constantinople fell in 1453 mainly because of Mehmed II's enormous cannons. According to this view, the giant guns smashed the city's ancient walls, and the thousand-year Byzantine Empire simply could not survive against such new weapons.

Text 2
Mehmed II's cannons did damage the walls of Constantinople, but the guns were slow to reload, and defenders often repaired the broken sections overnight. Historians point out that the city had only about seven thousand defenders facing a much larger Ottoman army. Mehmed also moved ships overland into the Golden Horn, cutting the city off by sea. These factors together, not cannons alone, explain the conquest.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the popular accounts described in Text 1?
problem.stimulus:
Text 1
Many popular accounts claim that Constantinople fell in 1453 mainly because of Mehmed II's enormous cannons. According to this view, the giant guns smashed the city's ancient walls, and the thousand-year Byzantine Empire simply could not survive against such new weapons.

Text 2
Mehmed II's cannons did damage the walls of Constantinople, but the guns were slow to reload, and defenders often repaired the broken sections overnight. Historians point out that the city had only about seven thousand defenders facing a much larger Ottoman army. Mehmed also moved ships overland into the Golden Horn, cutting the city off by sea. These factors together, not cannons alone, explain the conquest.
problem.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the popular accounts described in Text 1?
options: By arguing that these accounts give too much weight to a single cause and overlook other important reasons for the city's fall
By arguing that these accounts are correct because the cannons destroyed the walls faster than the defenders could repair them
By arguing that these accounts exaggerate the age of the Byzantine Empire and the strength of its walls
By arguing that these accounts wrongly suggest that Constantinople was ever conquered by the Ottomans
problem.explanation: Text 1의 대중적 설명은 함락의 주된 원인을 대포로 본다. Text 2는 대포가 피해를 주긴 했지만 방어군이 밤사이 보수했다고 하며, 적은 방어 병력과 배를 육로로 옮긴 봉쇄 같은 다른 요인을 들어 대포만으로는 설명할 수 없다고 결론짓는다. 따라서 A가 정답이다. B는 Text 2가 대포가 장전이 느렸고 성벽이 보수되었다고 말한 것과 반대된다. C는 Text 2가 제국의 역사나 성벽의 강도를 문제 삼지 않으므로 틀리고, D는 Text 2가 정복 자체는 인정하므로 틀리다.
problem.explanationEn: Text 1 describes accounts that treat Mehmed II's cannons as the main reason Constantinople fell. Text 2 agrees that the cannons did damage, but it notes that defenders repaired the walls overnight, then points to other factors: the small number of defenders and the ships moved overland to block the city by sea. Its conclusion is that these factors together, not cannons alone, explain the conquest, so A is correct. B is wrong because Text 2 says the guns were slow to reload and the walls were repaired, which is the opposite of B's claim. C is wrong because Text 2 never questions how old the empire was or how strong its walls were. D is wrong because Text 2 clearly accepts that the conquest happened.

quality.seed: history and civics — Ottoman siege of Constantinople 1453 and Mehmed II's conquest ending Byzantine Empire thousand-year history

hardJudge.note: Text 2의 마지막 문장("These factors together, not cannons alone")이 정답 A를 직접 뒷받침하며 한 단계 추론으로 해결 가능. 오답 B는 지문과 정반대, C는 언급 없음, D는 정복 자체 부정으로 전형적 오개념 유형이나 D는 다소 약함. 역사적 사실(약 7천 방어군, 골든혼 육로 선박 이동, 야간 보수, 느린 장전)은 통설과 일치. 해설 한·영 모두 일관되고 자연스러움.

advisory.note: Text 2의 'not cannons alone'에 단서가 직접 드러나 있어 easy 난이도에 맞음. 역사적 사실(방어군 약 7천 명, 골든혼으로 배를 육로 이동)도 정확함. D는 다소 약한 오답이지만 허용 범위임.

problem.passage:
Text 1
Many popular accounts of the end of slavery in the United States focus on lawmakers in Washington. In these accounts, the Thirteenth Amendment, ratified in 1865, was mainly the achievement of skilled politicians who guided it through Congress.

Text 2
The Thirteenth Amendment did not come from Congress alone. For decades before 1865, formerly enslaved speakers such as Frederick Douglass, along with ordinary petition signers in the United States and Britain, built the public pressure that made the amendment possible. Without that long campaign, lawmakers would likely never have acted.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the popular accounts described in Text 1?
problem.stimulus:
Text 1
Many popular accounts of the end of slavery in the United States focus on lawmakers in Washington. In these accounts, the Thirteenth Amendment, ratified in 1865, was mainly the achievement of skilled politicians who guided it through Congress.

Text 2
The Thirteenth Amendment did not come from Congress alone. For decades before 1865, formerly enslaved speakers such as Frederick Douglass, along with ordinary petition signers in the United States and Britain, built the public pressure that made the amendment possible. Without that long campaign, lawmakers would likely never have acted.
problem.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the popular accounts described in Text 1?
options: By agreeing that the amendment was achieved mostly through the skill of politicians in Congress
By arguing that these accounts overlook the years of activism that pushed lawmakers to act
By arguing that these accounts give too much credit to British supporters of the amendment
By agreeing that petition signers played only a minor role in ending slavery
problem.explanation: Text 1은 수정헌법 제13조를 주로 의회 정치인들의 업적으로 보는 통속적 서술을 소개하고, Text 2는 수십 년간의 노예제 폐지 운동이 만든 압력이 없었다면 의원들이 움직이지 않았을 것이라고 말한다. 따라서 Text 2의 저자는 그런 서술이 활동가들의 역할을 빠뜨렸다고 반박할 것이므로 B가 정답이다. A와 D는 Text 2가 명시적으로 부정하는 '정치인 중심'·'청원자 역할 미미' 관점에 동의하는 것이라 틀리다. C는 Text 1이 영국 지지자를 언급조차 하지 않으므로 근거가 없다.
problem.explanationEn: Text 1 describes popular accounts that credit the Thirteenth Amendment mainly to skilled politicians in Congress. Text 2 says decades of activism by speakers and petition signers created the pressure that made lawmakers act, so its author would say those accounts leave out that activism, which is B. A and D are wrong because they agree with the politician-centered view that Text 2 directly rejects. C is wrong because Text 1 never mentions British supporters, so there is no extra credit for Text 2 to complain about.

quality.seed: history and civics — Abolition movement anti-slavery activism 1780-1865 and transatlantic campaigns culminating in American Thirteenth Amendment

hardJudge.note: Text 2 explicitly states the amendment "did not come from Congress alone" and that without decades of activism "lawmakers would likely never have acted," directly supporting B. A and D contradict Text 2; C has no basis since Text 1 never mentions British supporters. Facts (1865 ratification, Douglass formerly enslaved, transatlantic petitioning) are accurate. Single-step inference with explicit textual cues and plausible-but-clearly-excludable distractors fits easy.

advisory.note: 대비가 명확하고 한 단계 추론으로 풀린다. D를 '정치인 중심 관점 동의'로 묶은 설명은 약간 느슨하지만(청원자 역할 축소 관점), 결론에는 문제없다.

problem.passage:
Historians have long credited the hostesses of Parisian salons, such as Julie de Lespinasse and Marie-Thérèse Geoffrin, with spreading the radical political ideas of the philosophes between 1750 and 1789. Historian Dena Goodman argues that these women did more than provide a meeting place: they set the rules of conversation, deciding who could speak and steering debates away from personal quarrels. But a closer look at salon records complicates the claim that hostesses actively promoted radical politics. Geoffrin, for instance, regularly barred discussion of current government policy at her gatherings and dropped guests whose writings drew the attention of royal censors, yet her salon remained one of the most important places where philosophes met to read and critique one another's unpublished work. Taken together, these facts suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
problem.stimulus: Historians have long credited the hostesses of Parisian salons, such as Julie de Lespinasse and Marie-Thérèse Geoffrin, with spreading the radical political ideas of the philosophes between 1750 and 1789. Historian Dena Goodman argues that these women did more than provide a meeting place: they set the rules of conversation, deciding who could speak and steering debates away from personal quarrels. But a closer look at salon records complicates the claim that hostesses actively promoted radical politics. Geoffrin, for instance, regularly barred discussion of current government policy at her gatherings and dropped guests whose writings drew the attention of royal censors, yet her salon remained one of the most important places where philosophes met to read and critique one another's unpublished work. Taken together, these facts suggest that ______
problem.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: Geoffrin's rules of conversation kept radical political ideas from circulating among the philosophes who attended her salon.
Geoffrin promoted radical political ideas more effectively than other hostesses did because she controlled which guests could attend.
a hostess's influence on Enlightenment thought may have come more from supporting the exchange of ideas in general than from championing radical political positions.
the philosophes valued salons mainly as places to escape the attention of royal censors rather than as forums for critiquing new work.
problem.explanation: 지문은 Geoffrin이 정치 논의를 막고 검열 대상이 된 손님을 배제했지만, 그녀의 살롱은 여전히 철학자들이 미발표 원고를 비평하는 중요한 장소였다고 말한다. 이 두 사실을 합치면, 살롱 주인의 영향력은 급진적 정치를 옹호하는 데서보다 사상 교류 전반을 지원하는 데서 나왔을 수 있다는 C가 가장 논리적이다. A는 정치 논의 금지라는 사실에는 맞지만, 그녀의 살롱이 사상 교류의 중심이었다는 점을 무시하고 급진 사상의 유통이 막혔다고 지나치게 단정한다. B는 손님 통제라는 사실을 근거로 삼지만, 그 통제가 오히려 급진 정치를 피하는 쪽으로 쓰였다는 점과 정반대다. D는 검열이라는 소재를 쓰지만, Geoffrin이 검열을 끄는 손님을 배제했다는 사실과 맞지 않고 비평 기능도 부정한다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage tells you Geoffrin banned talk about current policy and dropped guests who caught the censors' attention, yet her salon was still a key place for philosophes to critique one another's unpublished work. Put those two facts together and C follows best: a hostess's influence may have come from supporting the exchange of ideas in general, not from championing radical politics. A fits the ban on policy talk, but it ignores the salon's role as a center of exchange and claims too much when it says radical ideas were stopped from circulating. B points to Geoffrin's control over guests, but she used that control to avoid radical politics, which is the opposite of what B says. D brings up censorship, but Geoffrin actually pushed out guests the censors were watching, and D also downplays the critiquing that the passage stresses.

quality.seed: history and civics — Enlightenment salons Paris 1750-1789 and women intellectual gatekeepers promoting philosophe radical political ideas

hardJudge.note: 정답 C는 "정치 논의 금지·검열 대상 손님 배제"와 "미발표 원고 비평의 중심지"라는 두 사실을 결합해야 도출되며, 지문의 "complicates the claim that hostesses actively promoted radical politics"와 정확히 호응한다. A는 금지 사실에 부분 근거가 있으나 '급진 사상 유통 차단'은 과잉 단정(지문은 정부 정책 논의만 금지했다고 함), D는 검열 소재를 쓰지만 Geoffrin이 검열 대상 손님을 내보냈다는 사실과 충돌하고 비평 기능을 격하시킴, B는 손님 통제 사실을 반대 방향으로 해석. 두 단계 추론과 부분 근거 오답 구성이 medium 기준에 부합. Geoffrin이 살롱에서 정치·종교 논의를 금한 점, Goodman의 주장(Republic of Letters) 모두 역사적으로 타당. 한·영 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 해설 자연스럽고 한글 없음.

advisory.note: C가 'complicates' 문장 및 대조되는 두 사실과 논리적으로 맞물린다. A와 D는 지문의 일부 사실에 기대고 있어 비교해야 배제할 수 있다. B는 비교적 쉽게 배제되지만 말은 된다. 중간 난이도에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
Text 1
Historians have long explained Byzantine iconoclasm, the campaign against religious images that began under Emperor Leo III in 726 CE, as a theological dispute. On this view, Leo and his successors sincerely believed that venerating painted images of Christ and the saints amounted to idolatry, and the policy's eventual reversal in 843 CE reflected the triumph of a rival theology defending images.

Text 2
Surviving sources for the early phase of iconoclasm were written almost entirely by the image-venerating side after its victory, and they portray the iconoclast emperors as fanatics. Yet the few iconoclast documents that remain, such as the decrees of the council of 754 CE, do engage seriously with doctrine. What the victors' accounts obscure is how closely the emperors' policy tracked military fortune: images fell from favor after defeats by Arab armies and returned as the empire recovered, suggesting that rulers read battlefield results as signs of divine approval or anger.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the historians' explanation described in Text 1?
problem.stimulus:
Text 1
Historians have long explained Byzantine iconoclasm, the campaign against religious images that began under Emperor Leo III in 726 CE, as a theological dispute. On this view, Leo and his successors sincerely believed that venerating painted images of Christ and the saints amounted to idolatry, and the policy's eventual reversal in 843 CE reflected the triumph of a rival theology defending images.

Text 2
Surviving sources for the early phase of iconoclasm were written almost entirely by the image-venerating side after its victory, and they portray the iconoclast emperors as fanatics. Yet the few iconoclast documents that remain, such as the decrees of the council of 754 CE, do engage seriously with doctrine. What the victors' accounts obscure is how closely the emperors' policy tracked military fortune: images fell from favor after defeats by Arab armies and returned as the empire recovered, suggesting that rulers read battlefield results as signs of divine approval or anger.
problem.question: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the historians' explanation described in Text 1?
options: By granting that iconoclasts held real doctrinal convictions while arguing that this account overlooks how political circumstances shaped the policy's course
By granting that the policy changed over time while arguing that the iconoclast emperors held no genuine doctrinal convictions at all
By granting that doctrine shaped the policy while arguing that the council of 754 CE opposed the emperors' theology
By granting that image-venerating writers misrepresented the emperors while arguing that the controversy ended because Arab armies were finally defeated
problem.explanation: Text 2의 저자는 754년 공의회 문서가 교리를 진지하게 다룬다고 인정하므로 신학적 동기를 부정하지 않으면서도, 정책이 군사적 성패에 따라 오르내렸다는 점을 Text 1이 놓쳤다고 본다. 따라서 A가 정답이다. B는 Text 2가 황제들을 광신자로 그린 승자 측 서술을 비판하고 교리적 진지함을 인정하므로 틀리다. C는 754년 공의회가 황제의 신학에 반대했다는 근거가 없으며, 오히려 성상파괴 측 문서이다. D는 앞부분은 맞지만, Text 2는 제국의 회복을 성상 복귀와 연결할 뿐 아랍 군대의 최종 패배로 논쟁이 끝났다고 말하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The author of Text 2 admits that the council of 754 CE documents engage seriously with doctrine, so the author doesn't reject the theological motive. Instead, the author argues that Text 1's account misses how the policy rose and fell with military fortunes. That makes A the correct answer. B is wrong because Text 2 criticizes the victors' picture of the emperors as fanatics and acknowledges that they took doctrine seriously. C is wrong because the 754 council was an iconoclast source, and nothing in Text 2 says it opposed the emperors. D starts out plausibly, but Text 2 only links the empire's general recovery to the return of images; it never claims the controversy ended because Arab armies were finally defeated.

quality.seed: history and civics — Byzantine iconoclasm controversy 726-843 CE and religious conflict over religious image veneration in Eastern Christianity

hardJudge.note: Text 2 explicitly concedes that the 754 decrees "engage seriously with doctrine" and then argues the victors' accounts obscure the policy's tracking of military fortune — exactly A's concede-then-critique structure. B contradicts the concession; C misreads the iconoclast council as opposing the emperors; D's first half is supported but "ended because Arab armies were finally defeated" overstates "returned as the empire recovered." Dates (726, 754, 843) are historically accurate and the military-fortune interpretation reflects real scholarship. Both explanations match the answer key, reference the correct letters, and the English is natural with no Korean. Difficulty requires linking the concession to the critique and distinguishing degrees of overstatement in D — appropriate for medium.

advisory.note: A가 정답이며, Text 2가 교리적 진지함을 인정하면서 군사적 성패와의 연관을 덧붙인다는 점에 부합한다. 오답 B, C, D는 각각 일부 근거가 맞는 함정으로 구성되어 medium 난이도에 적합하다. 다만 'tracked military fortune'을 정치적 상황(political circumstances)으로 바꿔 말한 부분은 약간 일반화되어 있으나 허용 범위다.

problem.passage:
During the 1300s, merchants of the Hanseatic League won special trading rights from rulers in many Baltic port cities. These rights allowed League members alone to buy and sell grain, timber, and furs in those markets. ______ merchants from outside the League were largely shut out of the region's most profitable trade.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: During the 1300s, merchants of the Hanseatic League won special trading rights from rulers in many Baltic port cities. These rights allowed League members alone to buy and sell grain, timber, and furs in those markets. ______ merchants from outside the League were largely shut out of the region's most profitable trade.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 한자 동맹 상인만 곡물·목재·모피를 사고팔 수 있었다는 원인을 말하고, 마지막 문장은 그 때문에 외부 상인이 배제되었다는 결과를 말한다. 따라서 인과를 나타내는 C가 정답이다. A는 앞 내용의 구체적 사례를 들 때 쓰지만, 외부 상인의 배제는 사례가 아니라 결과이다. B는 대조를 나타내지만 두 문장은 서로 반대되지 않는다. D는 비슷한 다른 상황을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만, 여기서는 같은 상황이 낳은 결과를 말하고 있다.
problem.explanationEn: The previous sentence gives a cause: only League members could buy and sell grain, timber, and furs in those markets. The last sentence gives the effect: outside merchants were shut out. A cause-and-effect transition fits, so C is correct. A introduces an example, but being shut out is a consequence, not an example of the rights. B signals contrast, yet the two sentences don't oppose each other. D adds a similar but separate situation, while this sentence describes what followed from the same situation.

quality.seed: economics and business — Medieval Hanseatic League merchant network and Baltic trade monopoly in grain timber furs exchange

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(동맹 회원만 거래 가능)이 원인, 마지막 문장(외부 상인 배제)이 결과로 명확한 인과 관계. 'As a result'가 유일하게 논리적이며 오답은 전형적 전환어 범주 혼동(예시·대조·유사). 한·영 해설 결론 및 글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 한자 동맹 관련 사실 오류 없음. 단일 규칙·한 단계 추론·평이한 어휘로 easy 적합.

advisory.note: 인과 관계가 지문에 직접 드러나 한 단계 추론으로 풀 수 있다. 오답(예시·대조·유사)도 전형적인 오개념이다. 역사 사실(한자 동맹의 특권)은 대체로 타당하다.

problem.passage:
In the fifteenth century, diamond cutters in Antwerp adopted new polishing wheels that allowed them to shape stones into regular, symmetrical facets. Because these cuts followed consistent patterns, merchants could compare one stone with another far more easily than before. ______ buyers across Europe began to rely on shared standards when setting prices, and Antwerp grew into a major center of the diamond trade.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: In the fifteenth century, diamond cutters in Antwerp adopted new polishing wheels that allowed them to shape stones into regular, symmetrical facets. Because these cuts followed consistent patterns, merchants could compare one stone with another far more easily than before. ______ buyers across Europe began to rely on shared standards when setting prices, and Antwerp grew into a major center of the diamond trade.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 규칙적인 연마 방식 덕분에 상인들이 보석을 쉽게 비교할 수 있게 되었다고 말하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 그 때문에 구매자들이 공통 기준으로 가격을 정하게 되었다는 결과를 제시한다. 따라서 원인-결과 관계를 나타내는 D가 정답이다. A는 대조를 나타내지만 두 문장은 서로 반대되지 않는다. B는 예시를 나타내지만 뒤 문장은 비교가 쉬워졌다는 사실의 구체적 사례가 아니라 그로 인해 생긴 결과이다. C는 유사한 사례를 덧붙일 때 쓰지만 뒤 문장은 앞 문장과 비슷한 별개의 상황이 아니다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank says that regular cuts made diamonds easier to compare, and the sentence after it describes what happened because of that: buyers began using shared pricing standards. That is a cause-and-effect relationship, so D is correct. A signals contrast, but the two sentences don't oppose each other. B introduces an example, but the second sentence is a consequence, not a specific instance of stones becoming easier to compare. C points to a similar, separate case, but the second sentence follows directly from the first rather than paralleling it.

quality.seed: economics and business — Antwerp diamond trade fifteenth-century cutting techniques and gemstone valuation pricing standardization

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(규칙적 커팅→비교 용이)과 뒤 문장(공통 가격 기준 채택)이 명확한 인과 관계이므로 D 'As a result'가 유일한 논리적 선택. A(대조)·B(예시)·C(유사)는 전형적 오답으로 규칙을 알면 즉시 배제 가능. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 및 글자 참조 일치, 모순 없음, 영어 자연스러움. 15세기 안트베르펜 연마 기술 발전은 역사적으로 타당하며 저작권 의심 요소 없음. 단일 개념(인과 전환어), 단서 명시적, 어휘 평이 → easy 적합.

advisory.note: 명확한 인과 관계를 묻는 단일 규칙 문항이다. 오답은 대조, 예시, 유사를 나타내는 전형적인 연결어로 구성되어 있다. 15세기 안트베르펜의 연마 바퀴(scaif)와 다이아몬드 교역 중심지로의 성장은 역사적 사실에 부합한다.

problem.passage:
In 1720, shares in Britain's South Sea Company rose from about £128 to nearly £1,000 in just a few months. Company directors spread exaggerated stories about future trade profits, and many investors bought shares hoping to sell them quickly at even higher prices. By autumn, however, confidence collapsed and the share price ______, falling back below £200 and leaving thousands of investors with heavy losses.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: In 1720, shares in Britain's South Sea Company rose from about £128 to nearly £1,000 in just a few months. Company directors spread exaggerated stories about future trade profits, and many investors bought shares hoping to sell them quickly at even higher prices. By autumn, however, confidence collapsed and the share price ______, falling back below £200 and leaving thousands of investors with heavy losses.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 바로 뒤의 "falling back below £200"과 "heavy losses"는 주가가 갑자기 크게 떨어졌다는 것을 직접 보여 주므로, '급락하다'라는 뜻의 A가 정답이다. B는 '안정되다'라는 뜻으로 가격이 급격히 떨어진 상황과 맞지 않는다. C는 '치솟다'라는 뜻이어서 하락이라는 내용과 정반대이며, 앞부분의 상승 이야기만 보고 고르기 쉬운 오답이다. D는 '오르내리다'라는 뜻이어서 한 방향으로 급격히 떨어졌다는 의미를 정확히 담지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: Right after the blank, the text says the price was "falling back below £200" and left investors with "heavy losses." That tells you the price dropped sharply, so A, which means "fell suddenly and steeply," is correct. B means "became steady," which doesn't match such a dramatic drop. C means "rose rapidly," the opposite of falling; it's tempting only if you focus on the earlier part of the story, when prices went up. D means "moved up and down," which misses the clear one-way collapse the text describes.

quality.seed: economics and business — South Sea Bubble 1720 financial speculation and joint-stock company stock price manipulation scandal

hardJudge.note: 정답 A 검증: "confidence collapsed", "falling back below £200", "heavy losses"가 급락을 직접 지시하므로 plummeted가 유일하게 논리적·정밀함. B(안정), C(급등), D(등락)는 규칙(빈칸 뒤 단서 확인)을 알면 즉시 배제되지만 상승 서사에 끌리면 C, 변동성에 끌리면 D를 고를 법한 전형적 오개념으로 구성됨. 역사적 사실(1720 남해회사 버블, £128→~£1,000→연말 £200 미만 하락)도 대체로 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 선택지 글자 참조 일치, 결론 동일, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 지문은 독창적 서술로 저작권 의심 없음. 난이도 easy에 적합.

advisory.note: 단서 "falling back below £200", "collapsed"가 직접적이고 한 단계 추론으로 풀린다. 오답 soared(앞부분 상승에 이끌림)와 fluctuated(가격 변동이라는 일반 개념)는 그럴듯한 오개념이다. stabilized는 다소 약하지만 허용 범위다. 역사적 수치(£128→약 £1,000→가을 £200 미만)는 대체로 정확하다.

problem.passage:
From the early 1700s until 1845, Scotland had no central bank controlling its money. Instead, many private banks competed with one another, and each printed its own paper notes. Some observers expected such a system to collapse. In fact, Scottish banking proved remarkably ______: bank failures were rare, and people holding the notes of a failed bank almost never lost their money.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: From the early 1700s until 1845, Scotland had no central bank controlling its money. Instead, many private banks competed with one another, and each printed its own paper notes. Some observers expected such a system to collapse. In fact, Scottish banking proved remarkably ______: bank failures were rare, and people holding the notes of a failed bank almost never lost their money.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.explanation: 콜론 뒤의 설명(은행 파산이 드물었고 지폐 보유자가 돈을 거의 잃지 않았다)이 빈칸의 의미를 직접 알려 주며, 'In fact'는 붕괴할 것이라는 예상과 반대되는 결과를 나타낸다. 따라서 '안정적인'을 뜻하는 B가 정답이다. A는 중앙 규제가 없으면 혼란스러울 것이라는 예상에는 맞지만, 지문이 반박하는 바로 그 예상이다. C와 D는 비용이나 비밀성에 관한 말로, 파산이 드물고 손실이 적었다는 근거와 관련이 없다.
problem.explanationEn: The words after the colon explain the blank: bank failures were rare, and noteholders almost never lost money. "In fact" also tells you the result went against the prediction that the system would collapse. So B, "stable," is correct. A fits what the doubters expected, but the passage says that expectation was wrong. C and D are about cost and secrecy, and the evidence about rare failures and small losses says nothing about either one.

quality.seed: economics and business — Scottish banking system nineteenth-century free banking and note-issuing competition without central regulation

hardJudge.note: 콜론 뒤 설명(파산 드묾, 손실 거의 없음)과 'In fact'의 대조 신호가 빈칸을 직접 규정하여 B 'stable'이 유일하게 논리적임. A는 지문이 반박하는 예상(전형적 오개념 오답), C·D는 근거와 무관. 스코틀랜드 자유은행 시기(1700년대 초~1845) 서술도 역사적 통설과 일치. 한·영 해설 결론·선택지 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 단일 문맥 단서·한 단계 추론으로 easy 적합.

advisory.note: 콜론 뒤 단서와 'In fact' 대조로 한 단계에서 풀린다. 스코틀랜드 자유은행 시대(약 1716–1845, Peel의 1845년 법으로 종료)와 지폐 보유자 손실이 적었다는 서술은 통설과 맞는다. A는 그럴듯한 오개념이고, C·D는 약하지만 쉬운 난이도에서는 받아들일 만하다.

problem.passage:
During Japan's Meiji period (1868–1912), many silk filatures, the factories where silk thread is reeled from cocoons, began following national inspection rules so that they could compete in foreign markets. Under this system, each batch of thread was graded by its evenness and strength. The grading standards for raw silk ______ buyers in New York and Lyon a reliable way to compare thread from different Japanese mills, which helped Japan become the world's leading silk exporter by the early twentieth century.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: During Japan's Meiji period (1868–1912), many silk filatures, the factories where silk thread is reeled from cocoons, began following national inspection rules so that they could compete in foreign markets. Under this system, each batch of thread was graded by its evenness and strength. The grading standards for raw silk ______ buyers in New York and Lyon a reliable way to compare thread from different Japanese mills, which helped Japan become the world's leading silk exporter by the early twentieth century.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 "standards"이다. "for raw silk"는 주어를 꾸미는 수식어일 뿐이므로 동사는 복수형이어야 하고, 따라서 C "give"가 정답이다. A "gives", B "has given", D "is giving"은 모두 단수 동사형이다. 이 선택지들은 동사 바로 앞의 단수 명사 "silk"에 동사를 맞춘 경우로, 복수 주어와 수가 일치하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "standards." The phrase "for raw silk" only describes the subject, so the verb has to be plural, which makes C ("give") correct. A ("gives"), B ("has given"), and D ("is giving") are all singular verb forms. They match the singular noun "silk," which sits right before the blank, instead of the actual plural subject, so they don't agree in number.

quality.seed: economics and business — Japanese silk standardization Meiji period and quality grading export market competitiveness silk filature

hardJudge.note: 주어 "standards"(복수) + 수식어 "for raw silk" 구조에서 복수 동사 "give"만 수 일치. 나머지 세 선택지는 모두 단수형으로 근접 명사 "silk" 오개념을 겨냥한 전형적 오답. 해설(한/영) 결론·글자 참조 일치. 사소한 점: 지문 전체가 과거 시제인데 빈칸 선택지가 모두 현재 계열이라 "give"가 맥락상 다소 어색하나, 선택지 간 시제 차이가 없어 수 일치만 묻는 문항으로 성립하며 정답 판정에는 영향 없음. 메이지 시대 생사 검사·수출 관련 사실 오류 없음.

advisory.note: 주어-동사 수 일치만 보면 되는 easy 문항이다. 다만 메이지 시대의 과거 사실을 말하면서 뒤에 "helped"가 나오므로, 정답 "give"(현재형)는 시제상 다소 어색하다. 복수형 선택지가 하나뿐이라 정답은 정해지지만, 맥락에 맞추려면 "gave" 같은 과거형 틀이 더 자연스럽다.

problem.passage:
Portugal produces roughly half of the world's cork, much of it stripped by hand from the bark of cork oak trees in the Alentejo region. The country's largest cork company, along with its many smaller suppliers, ______ millions of wine stoppers each year, a level of output that has given Portugal a dominant position in the global market.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Portugal produces roughly half of the world's cork, much of it stripped by hand from the bark of cork oak trees in the Alentejo region. The country's largest cork company, along with its many smaller suppliers, ______ millions of wine stoppers each year, a level of output that has given Portugal a dominant position in the global market.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'company'이고, 'along with its many smaller suppliers'는 삽입된 수식어일 뿐 주어를 복수로 만들지 않는다. 따라서 단수 동사가 필요하며, D의 'manufactures'가 올바르다. A, B, C는 각각 복수 동사(manufacture, are manufacturing, have manufactured)로, 바로 앞의 'suppliers'나 'along with'를 'and'처럼 보고 주어를 복수로 착각한 오답이다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "company." The phrase "along with its many smaller suppliers" is just an added modifier, so it doesn't make the subject plural. That means the sentence needs a singular verb, and D, "manufactures," is correct. A, B, and C all use plural verbs ("manufacture," "are manufacturing," "have manufactured"). Those choices fall for the trap of treating the nearby word "suppliers," or the phrase "along with," as though it made the subject plural the way "and" would.

quality.seed: economics and business — Cork industry Portugal and wine bottle stopper manufacturing monopoly market dominance

hardJudge.note: 주어 'company'(단수) + 'along with' 삽입구 → 단수 동사 'manufactures'(D) 정답 확인. A·B·C는 모두 복수 동사로 'suppliers' 근접 오개념을 노린 전형적 오답. 해설 한·영 모두 일관되고 글자 참조 정확. 포르투갈 코르크 생산 비중·Alentejo 지역 서술도 사실에 부합. 단일 규칙(삽입구 무시 후 주어-동사 수 일치)으로 풀리는 easy 적합.

advisory.note: 주어-동사 수일치 문항이고, 'along with' 삽입구가 함정으로 쓰였다. 단일 규칙으로 풀 수 있고 오답 세 개 모두 같은 오개념에서 나온 그럴듯한 선택지라 easy 난이도에 맞다. 포르투갈이 세계 코르크의 약 절반을 생산한다는 내용은 사실과 맞다.

problem.passage:
In the mid-1800s, Swiss workshops began producing pocket watches with interchangeable, machine-made parts, which made accurate watches far cheaper than before. Economic historian Lena Marti argues that this drop in price helped railways run on tighter schedules: once ordinary station workers and conductors could afford reliable watches, she claims, trains could be coordinated to the minute rather than only roughly.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Marti's claim?
problem.stimulus: In the mid-1800s, Swiss workshops began producing pocket watches with interchangeable, machine-made parts, which made accurate watches far cheaper than before. Economic historian Lena Marti argues that this drop in price helped railways run on tighter schedules: once ordinary station workers and conductors could afford reliable watches, she claims, trains could be coordinated to the minute rather than only roughly.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Marti's claim?
options: Railway lines whose staff bought low-cost Swiss watches reported fewer late departures than lines whose staff did not have such watches.
Swiss watch exports to wealthy collectors rose sharply during the same decades that new railway lines were built.
Some railway companies printed their timetables in larger type after the 1860s so that passengers could read them easily.
Watchmakers in other countries also experimented with machine-made parts, though their watches remained costly.
problem.explanation: Marti의 주장은 '값싼 정확한 시계를 철도 직원이 갖게 되면서 열차 운행이 더 정밀하게 조정되었다'는 것이다. A는 저가 스위스 시계를 산 직원이 있는 노선이 지연 출발이 더 적었다는 발견으로, 시계 보급과 일정 정확성을 직접 연결해 주장을 지지한다. B는 부유한 수집가 대상 수출이라 일반 직원의 시계 보유와 무관하다. C는 시간표 인쇄 방식의 변화일 뿐 시계와 관련이 없고, D는 다른 나라 시계에 관한 내용이라 철도 일정과 연결되지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Marti claims that once railway workers could afford reliable, cheap watches, trains could be scheduled more precisely. Choice A directly connects workers owning low-cost Swiss watches with fewer late departures, so it supports the claim. Choice B is about wealthy collectors, not ordinary railway staff. Choice C describes a change in how timetables were printed, which has nothing to do with watches, and Choice D concerns watches from other countries without linking them to railway timing.

quality.seed: economics and business — Swiss watchmaking precision manufacturing and temporal standardization enabling railway schedule coordination

hardJudge.note: 지문·질문·선택지 형식 적합. 정답 A는 '직원의 저가 시계 보유 → 지연 감소'를 직접 연결해 Marti의 주장을 가장 직접적으로 지지함. B는 부유한 수집가(일반 직원 아님)로 전형적 오개념(같은 시기 상관관계), C는 시간표 가독성, D는 타국 시계—모두 규칙(주장의 핵심 연결고리 확인)을 알면 즉시 배제되지만 그럴듯함. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 결론·글자 참조 일치, 한글 혼입 없음. 가상의 역사가·주장이라 사실 오류 문제 없음. 단일 개념(주장 지지 증거 식별), 한 단계 추론, 평이한 어휘로 easy에 부합.

advisory.note: 단서가 직접 드러나 한 단계 추론으로 풀 수 있다. 오답 B(시계와 철도가 같은 시기에 함께 늘어남), C(철도 관련이지만 시계와 무관), D(기계 제작 부품)는 주장의 일부 요소만 공유하는 전형적인 함정 선택지다. 다만 '스위스 공방이 1800년대 중반에 기계 제작 호환 부품을 도입했다'는 역사적 설정은 다소 단순화된 서술이지만 가상 지문으로는 받아들일 수 있다.

problem.passage:
In the nineteenth century, German optical firms competed fiercely to make better lenses for microscopes and telescopes. Some firms protected their glass recipes with patents, which made the recipes public but legally barred others from copying them for a set period. Other firms kept their recipes as closely guarded workshop secrets. Economic historian Lena Hartmann argues that secrecy, not patenting, was the more effective way for these firms to protect their lens-making knowledge from rivals during this period.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Hartmann's claim?
problem.stimulus: In the nineteenth century, German optical firms competed fiercely to make better lenses for microscopes and telescopes. Some firms protected their glass recipes with patents, which made the recipes public but legally barred others from copying them for a set period. Other firms kept their recipes as closely guarded workshop secrets. Economic historian Lena Hartmann argues that secrecy, not patenting, was the more effective way for these firms to protect their lens-making knowledge from rivals during this period.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Hartmann's claim?
options: Firms that patented their glass recipes usually employed more workers than firms that kept their recipes secret.
Firms that kept their glass recipes secret were copied by rivals far less often than firms that patented their recipes.
Firms that patented their glass recipes often sold their lenses in more foreign countries than firms that kept their recipes secret.
Firms that kept their glass recipes secret spent more money on workshop equipment than firms that patented their recipes.
problem.explanation: Hartmann은 경쟁사로부터 렌즈 제조 지식을 지키는 데 특허보다 비밀 유지가 더 효과적이었다고 주장한다. B는 비밀을 유지한 회사가 경쟁사에게 훨씬 덜 모방당했다고 하므로 '보호 효과'를 직접 보여 주어 주장을 지지한다. A는 회사 규모를 다룰 뿐 지식 보호와는 관계가 없다. C는 해외 판매 범위에 관한 것이라 모방 방지 효과를 보여 주지 못한다. D는 장비 지출에 관한 것으로, 돈을 더 썼다고 해서 지식이 더 잘 보호되었다는 뜻은 아니다.
problem.explanationEn: Hartmann claims that keeping recipes secret protected lens-making knowledge from rivals better than patenting did. B says secret-keeping firms were copied far less often than patenting firms, and that directly shows better protection, so it supports her claim. A is about how many workers a firm had, which tells you nothing about protecting knowledge. C is about how many foreign markets a firm sold in, not about whether rivals copied it. D is about spending on equipment, and spending more money doesn't show that a firm's knowledge was better protected.

quality.seed: economics and business — Optical lens manufacturing patents and industrial espionage in nineteenth-century German optical instrument firms

hardJudge.note: 주장(비밀 유지가 특허보다 경쟁사로부터 지식을 보호하는 데 더 효과적)에 대해 B만이 '모방당한 빈도'라는 보호 효과의 직접 지표를 제시한다. A(고용 규모), C(해외 판매), D(장비 지출)는 모두 주제와 관련 있어 보이지만 보호 효과와 무관한 전형적 오답. 지문은 가상의 역사학자(Lena Hartmann)를 사용한 오리지널 서술로 보이며, 특허의 공개성·배타성 설명도 사실에 부합한다. 한·영 해설 모두 정답 B 및 오답 배제 논리가 일치하며 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 한 단계 추론으로 풀리는 easy 수준에 적합.

advisory.note: B는 주장의 핵심인 '경쟁사 모방 방지'와 바로 연결된다. 오답들은 회사 규모, 해외 판매, 장비 지출처럼 성공과 관련된 것처럼 보이는 지표라서 그럴듯한 오개념 선택지다. 한 단계 추론으로 풀 수 있어 easy에 맞다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Mombasa Tea Auction in Kenya is one of the largest tea auctions in the world.
- It is run by the East African Tea Trade Association, founded in 1957.
- Each week, buyers bid on lots of tea, and the highest bid sets the price for that lot.
- This bidding process lets prices reflect current demand for different teas.
- Many Kenyan smallholder farmers sell their leaves through cooperatives whose tea is sold at the auction.

The student wants to explain how prices are determined at the Mombasa Tea Auction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Mombasa Tea Auction in Kenya is one of the largest tea auctions in the world.
- It is run by the East African Tea Trade Association, founded in 1957.
- Each week, buyers bid on lots of tea, and the highest bid sets the price for that lot.
- This bidding process lets prices reflect current demand for different teas.
- Many Kenyan smallholder farmers sell their leaves through cooperatives whose tea is sold at the auction.
problem.question: The student wants to explain how prices are determined at the Mombasa Tea Auction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The Mombasa Tea Auction, one of the largest tea auctions in the world, is run by the East African Tea Trade Association.
Many Kenyan smallholder farmers sell their leaves through cooperatives, and that tea is sold at the Mombasa Tea Auction.
At the Mombasa Tea Auction, buyers bid on lots of tea each week, and the highest bid sets each lot's price, so prices reflect current demand.
The East African Tea Trade Association, which runs the Mombasa Tea Auction, was founded in 1957.
problem.explanation: 목표는 경매에서 가격이 어떻게 정해지는지 설명하는 것입니다. C는 구매자들이 입찰하고 가장 높은 입찰가가 가격이 되며, 그 결과 가격이 수요를 반영한다고 설명하므로 정답입니다. A는 경매의 규모와 운영 기관만 소개하고, D는 운영 기관의 설립 연도만 제시합니다. B는 소농이 차를 어떻게 판매하는지를 설명할 뿐 가격 결정 방식에는 답하지 않습니다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain how prices are set at the auction. C does this: buyers bid, the highest bid sets each lot's price, and so prices reflect demand. A only gives the auction's size and who runs it, and D only gives the year the association was founded. B describes how smallholder farmers sell their tea, but it never explains how the price is set.

quality.seed: economics and business — Kenyan tea auction system Mombasa and price discovery mechanism for smallholder farmer cooperative sales

hardJudge.note: 정답 C는 노트 3·4번을 정확히 결합해 가격 결정 방식(입찰→최고가→수요 반영)을 설명함. A·B·D는 모두 노트에 근거한 사실이지만 가격 결정 과정과 무관한 전형적 오답(규모/운영기관, 판매 경로, 설립 연도)으로 easy 난이도에 적합. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 글자 참조 일치, 모순 없음, 영어 자연스러움. 사실관계(EATTA 1957 설립, 몸바사 경매 규모)도 실제와 부합.

advisory.note: 목표(가격 결정 방식)와 직접 맞는 선택지는 C 하나뿐이고, 나머지 선택지는 노트에 있는 관련 없는 정보를 정확히 옮긴 전형적인 오답이다. 쉬운 난이도에 맞는 rhetorical synthesis 문항이다. 사실관계(EATTA 1957년 설립, 몸바사 경매)도 맞다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Copra is the dried meat, or kernel, of the coconut.
- Coconut oil is pressed from copra and was used in soap, margarine, and candles.
- In the early 1900s, the Philippines was under United States colonial rule.
- During that period, much of the copra grown in the Philippines was shipped abroad for processing.
- As a result, many Filipino farming communities relied on a single export crop whose price was set by foreign buyers.

The student wants to explain what copra is to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Copra is the dried meat, or kernel, of the coconut.
- Coconut oil is pressed from copra and was used in soap, margarine, and candles.
- In the early 1900s, the Philippines was under United States colonial rule.
- During that period, much of the copra grown in the Philippines was shipped abroad for processing.
- As a result, many Filipino farming communities relied on a single export crop whose price was set by foreign buyers.
problem.question: The student wants to explain what copra is to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: In the early 1900s, copra was grown in the Philippines while the country was under United States colonial rule.
Copra grown in the Philippines was often shipped abroad, leaving farmers dependent on prices set by foreign buyers.
Copra was a crop that many Filipino farming communities relied on as their single export.
Copra, the dried kernel of the coconut, is the source of an oil once used in soap, margarine, and candles.
problem.explanation: 목표는 copra를 모르는 독자에게 copra가 무엇인지 설명하는 것이다. D는 copra가 코코넛의 말린 과육이며 비누·마가린·양초에 쓰인 기름의 원료라고 정의와 용도를 함께 제시하므로 정답이다. A는 copra가 재배된 시기와 정치적 배경만 말하고 그것이 무엇인지는 설명하지 않는다. B와 C는 수출과 경제적 의존을 다룰 뿐, copra가 무엇인지 모르는 독자에게 정의를 주지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain what copra is to readers who have never heard of it. D works because it defines copra as the dried kernel of the coconut and tells what its oil was used for. A only gives the time and political setting in which copra was grown, so it never says what copra actually is. B and C talk about exports and economic dependence, but neither one defines copra, so an unfamiliar reader still wouldn't know what it is.

quality.seed: economics and business — Filipino copra trade coconut oil production and colonial extraction economic dependency patterns

hardJudge.note: D만이 copra의 정의(코코넛의 말린 과육)와 용도를 노트 1·2에서 가져와 제시한다. A·B·C는 노트에 근거한 사실이지만 '무엇인가'를 설명하지 않아 목표에 부합하지 않는다. 오답들은 노트 내용을 그대로 반영해 그럴듯하며, 단일 기준(목표=정의 제공)으로 바로 배제 가능하므로 easy에 적합하다. 노트 내용(copra 정의, 코코넛 오일 용도, 필리핀 미국 식민지 시기)은 사실과 부합하고, 한국어·영어 해설은 결론과 글자 참조가 일치하며 한글 혼입 없음.

advisory.note: 정의 제공 여부라는 단일 기준만으로 풀 수 있다. D만 정의를 담고 있고, 오답은 노트 내용을 정확히 옮겨 그럴듯해 보이지만 목표와는 맞지 않는다. 선택지 길이도 고르게 맞춰져 있다.

problem.passage:
In 1892, Daniel Swarovski patented an electric machine that could cut and polish glass crystals far faster and more precisely than skilled workers could by hand. The invention allowed his small Austrian firm to supply sparkling stones to fashion jewelers at a fraction of the usual ______ costume jewelry soon became affordable to shoppers who could never have bought diamonds.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In 1892, Daniel Swarovski patented an electric machine that could cut and polish glass crystals far faster and more precisely than skilled workers could by hand. The invention allowed his small Austrian firm to supply sparkling stones to fashion jewelers at a fraction of the usual ______ costume jewelry soon became affordable to shoppers who could never have bought diamonds.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 'The invention allowed ... usual price'와 뒤 'costume jewelry soon became affordable ...'는 각각 독립절이다. 'as a result'는 접속사가 아닌 연결부사이므로 두 독립절은 마침표로 나누어야 하며, B가 이를 지킨다. A와 D는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 스플라이스가 된다. C는 구두점 없이 두 독립절을 붙여 무종지문(run-on)이 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The words before the blank ("The invention allowed ... usual price") form an independent clause, and so do the words after it ("costume jewelry soon became affordable ..."). "As a result" is a transitional phrase, not a conjunction, so the two clauses need to be split with a period, and that's what B does. A and D join the two independent clauses with only a comma, which makes a comma splice. C uses no punctuation at all between the clauses, so it creates a run-on sentence.

quality.seed: economics and business — Swarovski crystal cutting technology and fashion jewelry mass production innovation Austrian firm

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞뒤 모두 독립절이며 'as a result'는 연결부사이므로 마침표로 분리한 B만 정답. A·D는 쉼표 스플라이스, C는 무종지문으로 설명과 일치. 역사적 사실(1892년 Swarovski 특허)도 정확. 연결부사+독립절 구두점이라는 단일 규칙으로 해결되는 전형적 easy 문항.

advisory.note: 독립절 두 개를 연결부사 'as a result'로 잇는 전형적인 easy 문항이다. 오답 A·D(쉼표 스플라이스)와 C(무종지문)는 대표적인 오개념이다. 사실관계: 1892년 특허는 맞다. 회사(Wattens)는 1895년에 설립되었지만, 지문은 발명이 이후 회사의 공급을 가능하게 했다는 뜻으로 읽을 수 있어 허용 범위다.

problem.passage:
After the United Nations imposed sanctions on Rhodesia in 1966, the colony's tobacco trade, which had previously supplied a large share of the leaf bought by British cigarette manufacturers, ______ to survive by routing harvests through intermediaries in neighboring countries and selling them under falsified certificates of origin.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: After the United Nations imposed sanctions on Rhodesia in 1966, the colony's tobacco trade, which had previously supplied a large share of the leaf bought by British cigarette manufacturers, ______ to survive by routing harvests through intermediaries in neighboring countries and selling them under falsified certificates of origin.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 "trade"이고, which로 시작하는 관계절은 수식어일 뿐이므로 주절에는 정동사가 필요하다. D의 "attempted"는 단수 주어와 맞는 과거 정동사이므로 문장이 완성된다. A의 "attempting"과 C의 "having attempted"는 분사라서 주절에 정동사가 없게 되어 문장이 불완전해진다. B의 "were attempting"은 정동사이긴 하지만 바로 앞의 복수 명사 "manufacturers"에 수를 맞춘 복수형이어서 단수 주어 "trade"와 일치하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "trade." The "which" clause is only a modifier, so the main clause still needs a finite verb. D, "attempted," is a finite past-tense verb that works with a singular subject, so it completes the sentence correctly. A ("attempting") and C ("having attempted") are participles, which means the main clause would have no finite verb and the sentence would be a fragment. B ("were attempting") is a finite verb, but it's plural, as if it agreed with the nearby noun "manufacturers," so it doesn't agree with the singular subject "trade."

quality.seed: economics and business — Rhodesian tobacco sanctions economic embargo and global trade disruption agricultural export collapse

hardJudge.note: 주어 "trade"(단수) + 긴 which 관계절 뒤 정동사 필요. D "attempted"만 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사. B는 인접 명사 "manufacturers"에 끌린 복수형 오답, A·C는 분사로 문장 미완성. 역사적 배경(1966년 UN 제재, 로디지아 담배의 영국 수출, 원산지 증명서 위조를 통한 제재 회피)도 사실에 부합. 한/영 해설 모두 정답·글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스러움. 수식어 건너뛰기 + 수 일치 확인의 두 단계 판단으로 medium 적합.

advisory.note: 주어 trade와 동사 사이에 긴 관계절이 들어가 있어 정동사 여부와 수 일치를 함께 따져야 한다. 오답 B는 가까운 복수 명사를 노린 함정이다. 사실관계(1966년 UN 제재, 원산지 위조를 통한 우회 수출)도 맞다.

problem.passage:
Across the Philippines, millions of people depend on coconut farming, yet most smallholder producers do not own the land they cultivate. The tenancy arrangements common in provinces such as Quezon, which often require a farmer to surrender a large share of each copra harvest to an absentee landowner, ______ household incomes far below those of farmers who hold title to their own plots.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Across the Philippines, millions of people depend on coconut farming, yet most smallholder producers do not own the land they cultivate. The tenancy arrangements common in provinces such as Quezon, which often require a farmer to surrender a large share of each copra harvest to an absentee landowner, ______ household incomes far below those of farmers who hold title to their own plots.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 'arrangements'이고, 'which ~ landowner'는 주어를 꾸미는 삽입 관계절이다. 따라서 빈칸에는 복수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 정동사이지만 빈칸 바로 앞의 단수 명사 'landowner'에 수를 맞춘 것이어서 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C와 D는 분사 형태라 정동사 역할을 할 수 없어서, 문장에 본동사가 없는 비문이 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "arrangements," and the clause "which often require... landowner" just interrupts between the subject and its verb. The blank therefore needs a finite verb that agrees with a plural subject, so A is correct. B is a finite verb, but it is singular because it matches the nearby noun "landowner" rather than the real subject. C and D are participle forms, which can't serve as the main verb, so either one would leave the sentence without a main verb.

quality.seed: economics and business — Philippine coconut industry labor practices and land tenure inequality affecting smallholder producer incomes

hardJudge.note: 주어 'arrangements'(복수)와 삽입 관계절 뒤 정동사 일치 문제. 정답 A 'keep' 검산 완료. B는 근접 명사 'landowner'에 이끌리는 매력적 오답, C/D는 비정동사로 본동사 부재. 한·영 해설 모두 정답과 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 자연스러움. 필리핀 코코넛 소작 관행 서술에 사실 오류 없음. medium 적합.

advisory.note: 주어(arrangements)와 동사 사이에 긴 관계절이 끼어 있고 그 앞에 단수 명사 landowner, Quezon이 있어, 훑어 읽으면 B를 고르기 쉬운 구조다. 주어를 찾고 동사 형태를 판단하는 두 단계가 필요해 medium 난이도에 맞다. 다만 C·D는 정동사가 없다는 이유 하나로 바로 배제되어 함정 역할이 약간 약하다.

problem.passage:
In the mid-nineteenth century, British planters in Bengal controlled much of the world's supply of natural indigo, a blue dye extracted from the leaves of Indigofera plants. Their dominance, however, proved fragile: after German chemists developed an inexpensive synthetic version in 1897, the price of indigo produced by the Bengali estates, which had already been weakened by peasant revolts against coercive cultivation contracts, ______ so sharply that many plantations shut down within two decades.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the mid-nineteenth century, British planters in Bengal controlled much of the world's supply of natural indigo, a blue dye extracted from the leaves of Indigofera plants. Their dominance, however, proved fragile: after German chemists developed an inexpensive synthetic version in 1897, the price of indigo produced by the Bengali estates, which had already been weakened by peasant revolts against coercive cultivation contracts, ______ so sharply that many plantations shut down within two decades.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 절의 주어는 단수 명사 'the price'이며, 'of indigo produced by the Bengali estates'와 관계절 'which had ... contracts'는 주어를 꾸미는 수식어일 뿐이므로 단수 정동사가 필요하고, 1897년 이후의 과거 사건이므로 과거시제가 맞다. 따라서 A가 정답이다. B는 과거시제이긴 하지만 바로 앞의 복수 명사 'estates'나 'contracts'에 이끌린 복수형 'were'라서 단수 주어와 맞지 않는다. C는 복수형인 데다 현재완료여서 과거 서술 문맥에도 어긋난다. D는 분사라 'after'절 뒤의 주절에 정동사가 없게 되어 문장이 성립하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this clause is the singular noun "the price." The phrase "of indigo produced by the Bengali estates" and the clause "which had ... contracts" only modify that subject, so you need a singular finite verb, and because the events happened after 1897, it should be in the past tense. That makes A correct. B is past tense, but "were" is plural, so it agrees with the nearby plural nouns "estates" or "contracts" instead of "price." C is also plural, and its present perfect tense doesn't fit a narrative about the past. D is a participle, which would leave the main clause after the "after" clause without a finite verb.

quality.seed: economics and business — Bengali indigo cartel monopoly India and synthetic dye competition natural pigment market displacement

hardJudge.note: 주어 'the price'(단수)와 동사 사이에 'of indigo produced by the Bengali estates' 및 관계절 'which had already been weakened ... contracts'가 끼어 있어, 수 일치(단수) + 시제(1897년 이후 과거 서술) 두 단계 판단이 필요하다. advisory.note: 주어 'price'와 동사 사이에 수식어구와 관계절이 길게 끼어 있어, 동사의 수 일치와 시제를 함께 판단해야 한다. 매력적인 오답 B도 있어 medium 난이도에 적합하다. 역사적 사실(1897년 합성 인디고 상용화, 벵골 인디고 농민 봉기)도 대체로 정확하다.

problem.passage:
Drawn up at the request of Emperor Napoleon III for the 1855 Exposition Universelle in Paris, the Bordeaux classification sorted dozens of Médoc estates into five tiers, or "growths," based largely on the prices their wines had commanded for decades. Remarkably, the hierarchy, which brokers compiled from merchants' sales records rather than from tastings of the wines themselves, ______ almost unchanged for more than 160 years, and economists note that an estate's tier still reliably predicts the price its bottles fetch today.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Drawn up at the request of Emperor Napoleon III for the 1855 Exposition Universelle in Paris, the Bordeaux classification sorted dozens of Médoc estates into five tiers, or "growths," based largely on the prices their wines had commanded for decades. Remarkably, the hierarchy, which brokers compiled from merchants' sales records rather than from tastings of the wines themselves, ______ almost unchanged for more than 160 years, and economists note that an estate's tier still reliably predicts the price its bottles fetch today.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'the hierarchy'이고, 그 뒤에 이어지는 'which ... themselves' 관계절은 주어와 동사 사이에 끼어든 삽입 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 빈칸에는 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 B가 정답이다. A는 빈칸 바로 앞의 복수 명사(records, wines)에 맞춘 복수 동사여서 주어 'hierarchy'와 수가 일치하지 않는다. C와 D는 분사 형태라서 'the hierarchy'로 시작하는 절에 정동사가 없게 되고, 그 결과 ', and economists note...'와 연결되는 앞 절이 문법적으로 불완전해진다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this clause is the singular noun "the hierarchy." The relative clause "which ... themselves" just interrupts between the subject and its verb. So the blank needs a finite verb that agrees with a singular subject, and that makes B correct. A is a plural verb that matches the nearby plural nouns "records" and "wines" instead of the real subject, "hierarchy." C and D are participles, so they leave the clause starting with "the hierarchy" without a main verb. That makes the first clause, which is joined to ", and economists note...", grammatically incomplete.

quality.seed: economics and business — Bordeaux wine classification system 1855 and producer ranking prestige pricing hierarchical market segmentation

hardJudge.note: 주어 'the hierarchy'(단수)와 삽입 관계절 뒤의 정동사 일치 문제. B 'has remained'가 유일하게 단수 정동사로 옳음. A는 인접 복수 명사(records, wines, themselves)에 의한 근접 일치 오답으로 매력적이며, C/D는 비정형 동사로 절에 정동사가 없게 됨. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답과 선택지 글자 참조가 일치하고 모순 없음. 1855 보르도 등급 관련 사실(나폴레옹 3세 요청, 파리 만국박람회, 메독, 5등급, 가격 기반, 중개인 작성) 정확. 삽입 수식어 건너뛰기 + 정동사 필요성 판단의 두 단계로 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 긴 삽입 관계절 때문에 복수 명사(records, wines)에 끌려 A를 고르게 만드는 함정이 있고, 정동사와 분사를 구별해야 해서 판단이 두 단계로 이루어진다. 중간 난이도에 맞는다.

problem.stimulus: Norway's salmon farms, which produce more than a million metric tons of fish each year, have long been praised as an economic success. Yet economists studying the industry argue that its low market prices conceal real costs: sea lice that breed in crowded open-net pens and spread to wild salmon, along with nutrient waste released into the fjords, ______ by coastal communities and fisheries rather than by the farming companies themselves.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 콜론 뒤 절의 주어는 'sea lice'(복수)이며, 'along with nutrient waste...'는 삽입된 수식어이므로 주어의 수에 영향을 주지 않는다. 또한 이 절에는 정동사가 필요하므로 복수 정동사 C가 정답이다. A는 정동사이지만 바로 앞 단수 명사 'waste'나 'fjords' 근처 구조에 끌린 단수형이라 주어와 수가 맞지 않는다. B와 D는 분사형이라 콜론 뒤 절에 정동사가 없게 되어 불완전한 문장이 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The clause after the colon has the subject "sea lice," which is plural. The phrase "along with nutrient waste released into the fjords" is an added modifier, so it doesn't change the number of the subject. That clause also needs a main verb, so the plural main verb in C is correct. A is a main verb, but it's singular, probably pulled that way by the nearby noun "waste," so it doesn't agree with the subject. B and D are participles, which would leave the clause after the colon with no main verb and make it incomplete.

hardJudge.note: 콜론 뒤 독립절의 주어 'sea lice'(복수)와 삽입구 'along with nutrient waste released into the fjords' 사이의 거리 때문에 두 단계 판단(주어 식별 + 정동사 필요)이 요구되어 medium에 적합. A는 근접 명사 끌림으로 그럴듯한 오답, B·D는 정동사 부재. 의미상 '비용'이 아니라 'sea lice'가 borne by communities로 읽히는 점이 다소 어색하나 문법 판단에는 지장 없음.

advisory.note: 긴 삽입구(along with...)와 가까운 단수 명사 'waste'가 수 일치 함정을 만들고, 정동사 필요 여부까지 판단해야 하므로 두 단계 판단이 필요하다. 중간 난이도에 적합하다. B를 콜론 뒤 명사구 동격으로 읽을 여지가 아주 약간 있지만, 'being'이 어색해서 SAT 기준으로는 배제된다.

Many grain farmers who once sold their entire harvest at whatever price the local elevator offered at harvest time now use futures contracts to set a price months in advance. problem.stimulus: Many grain farmers who once sold their entire harvest at whatever price the local elevator offered at harvest time now use futures contracts to set a price months in advance. According to a survey of Kansas wheat growers, the practice of hedging a portion of expected yield, especially among operators managing more than 1,000 acres, ______ farm income from one year to the next, allowing families to plan major equipment purchases with greater confidence.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: "according to" 뒤 절의 주어는 "the practice"(단수)이고, "of hedging ... 1,000 acres"는 이를 꾸미는 수식어구이다. 이 절에는 정동사가 없으므로 빈칸에는 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하며, 따라서 D가 정답이다. B는 정동사이긴 하지만 바로 앞의 복수 명사 "acres"에 맞춘 복수형이라 주어와 수가 일치하지 않는다. A의 분사와 C의 부정사는 정동사가 아니어서 절이 완성되지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the clause after "according to" is the singular noun "the practice," and the phrase "of hedging ... 1,000 acres" just modifies it. That clause has no main verb yet, so the blank needs a finite verb that agrees with a singular subject, which makes D the answer. B is a finite verb, but it's plural because it matches the nearby noun "acres" instead of the real subject. A, a participle, and C, an infinitive, aren't finite verbs, so the clause would be left incomplete.

quality.seed: economics and business — Agricultural hedging futures adoption and commodity price risk management strategy farmer financial security

hardJudge.note: 주어 "the practice"(단수)와 긴 수식어구("of hedging ... 1,000 acres") 사이의 거리로 인해 "acres/operators"에 끌리는 B가 매력적인 오답으로 기능하며, 절에 정동사가 없으므로 A·C는 배제됨. D 정답 확인. 한·영 해설 모두 결론과 글자 참조가 일치하고 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 수식어 건너뛰기 + 정동사 필요 여부 판단의 두 단계로 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 긴 삽입 수식어와 바로 앞의 복수 명사 acres(및 operators)가 B를 유인한다. 이 때문에 정동사가 필요한지와 주어의 수를 함께 따지는 두 단계 판단이 필요해 medium에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
According to the dual labor market hypothesis, proposed by economists Peter Doeringer and Michael Piore in 1971, the persistent differences in pay between jobs in the primary sector, which offers stable employment and clear paths to promotion, and jobs in the secondary sector ______ not simply from differences in workers' skills; rather, they reflect institutional barriers that make it difficult for workers to move from one sector to the other.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: According to the dual labor market hypothesis, proposed by economists Peter Doeringer and Michael Piore in 1971, the persistent differences in pay between jobs in the primary sector, which offers stable employment and clear paths to promotion, and jobs in the secondary sector ______ not simply from differences in workers' skills; rather, they reflect institutional barriers that make it difficult for workers to move from one sector to the other.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 세미콜론 앞 절의 주어는 복수 명사 "differences"이고, "in pay between jobs in the primary sector... and jobs in the secondary sector"는 이를 꾸미는 긴 수식어구다. 따라서 이 절에는 복수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 정동사이긴 하지만 빈칸 바로 앞의 단수 명사 "sector"에 맞춘 단수형이어서 주어 "differences"와 수가 일치하지 않는다. C와 D는 분사 형태라 절에 정동사가 없게 되어 세미콜론 앞부분이 완전한 문장이 되지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the clause before the semicolon is the plural noun "differences," and the long phrase "in pay between jobs in the primary sector... and jobs in the secondary sector" just modifies it. That means the clause needs a finite verb that agrees with a plural subject, so A is correct. B is a finite verb, but it's singular. It agrees with "sector," the singular noun right before the blank, not with the real subject, "differences." C and D are participles, so they'd leave the clause without a main verb, and the part before the semicolon wouldn't be a complete sentence.

quality.seed: economics and business — Dual labor market segmentation hypothesis and persistent wage inequality between primary secondary sectors

hardJudge.note: 주어 "differences"(복수)와 빈칸 동사 사이에 긴 전치사구·관계절 수식어가 끼어 있고, 빈칸 직전 단수 명사 "sector"가 B를 유인하는 구조로 설계됨. 정답 A(arise) 검산 완료. C·D는 정동사 부재로 배제되며 세미콜론 뒤 "they reflect"와의 병렬도 복수 주어를 뒷받침함. Doeringer·Piore 1971 이중노동시장론 기술도 사실에 부합. 한·영 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 해설 자연스러움. 표준 SAT medium 수준의 주어-동사 일치 문항으로 적합.

advisory.note: 주어 differences와 동사 사이에 수식어가 길게 끼어 있고 바로 앞에 단수 sector가 있어 주의를 흐트러뜨린다. 정동사를 고른 뒤 수 일치까지 확인해야 하는 두 단계 판단이 필요하므로 medium에 맞다. Doeringer·Piore(1971)라는 사실 정보도 정확하다.

problem.passage:
Economists have long assumed that the internet would weaken the pull of geography on startup funding: if investors can review pitch decks and hold meetings from anywhere, capital should flow more evenly across regions. Venture capital firms, however, rarely invest alone; they form syndicates, sharing deals with partners they already know and trust. A 2021 analysis of more than 9,000 early-stage deals found that firms based outside major hubs were far more likely to join a syndicate when a lead investor from Silicon Valley or Boston was already involved. ______ the networks that were expected to spread capital outward have tended to route it back through a few established centers.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Economists have long assumed that the internet would weaken the pull of geography on startup funding: if investors can review pitch decks and hold meetings from anywhere, capital should flow more evenly across regions. Venture capital firms, however, rarely invest alone; they form syndicates, sharing deals with partners they already know and trust. A 2021 analysis of more than 9,000 early-stage deals found that firms based outside major hubs were far more likely to join a syndicate when a lead investor from Silicon Valley or Boston was already involved. ______ the networks that were expected to spread capital outward have tended to route it back through a few established centers.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 마지막 문장은 앞 문장의 연구 결과(외부 투자자가 실리콘밸리·보스턴 주도 투자자를 따라 신디케이트에 참여함)가 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지 요약·해석하는 문장이므로 C가 정답이다. A는 지문 전체에 '기대 vs. 현실'의 대조가 있어 그럴듯해 보이지만, 바로 앞 문장과 마지막 문장은 서로 반대되는 내용이 아니라 같은 방향의 내용이다. B는 마지막 문장이 구체적 사례가 아니라 오히려 앞 사례를 일반화한 결론이므로 맞지 않는다. D는 새로운 유사 현상을 덧붙이는 것이 아니라 같은 현상을 해석하는 문장이므로 부적절하다.
problem.explanationEn: The last sentence sums up what the study's finding actually means: if investors outside the hubs mostly join deals led by Silicon Valley or Boston firms, then capital keeps flowing back through those centers. That makes C the answer. A looks tempting because the passage as a whole contrasts expectation with reality, but the sentence right before the blank and the final sentence point in the same direction, so they don't contrast. B is wrong because the final sentence isn't a specific example; it's a general conclusion drawn from the example before it. D is wrong because the final sentence doesn't add a separate, similar phenomenon; it interprets the same one.

quality.seed: economics and business — Venture capital syndication networks technology hubs and geographic concentration startup funding Silicon Valley dominance

hardJudge.note: 마지막 문장은 직전 연구 결과의 실질적 의미를 요약하는 문장이므로 'In effect'(C)가 유일하게 성립한다. A는 지문 전체의 '기대 vs 현실' 구도 때문에 훑어 읽으면 고르기 쉬운 강력한 오답이고(단, 직전 문장과는 대조가 아님), D는 같은 방향의 내용이라 부분적 근거가 있으며, B도 표면적으로 그럴듯하다. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답과 선택지 글자 참조가 일치하고 모순 없음. 2021년 9,000건 분석은 가상의 일반적 서술로 사실 오류·저작권 의심 요소 없음. 난이도 medium 적합.

advisory.note: 'In effect'는 앞 문장의 결과를 해석·요약하는 역할로 적절하다. 'Nevertheless'는 첫 문장의 기대와 대조된다는 점 때문에 매력적인 오답이 되어 medium 난이도에 맞다. 다만 첫 문장에서 기대의 주체는 'internet'인데 마지막 문장에서는 'networks that were expected'로 바뀌어 연결이 약간 느슨하다. 정답 판정에는 영향이 없다.

Automated valuation models (AVMs) estimate a home's worth by analyzing recent sales of comparable properties nearby, and lenders increasingly rely on them because they promise to remove the subjective judgments of human appraisers. Removing the appraiser, however, does not remove history. In neighborhoods where decades of discriminatory lending held down sale prices, the comparable sales an AVM draws on already carry that suppressed value. ______ a model that never considers a homeowner's race can still assign systematically lower valuations to homes in predominantly Black neighborhoods, limiting how much those owners can borrow.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Automated valuation models (AVMs) estimate a home's worth by analyzing recent sales of comparable properties nearby, and lenders increasingly rely on them because they promise to remove the subjective judgments of human appraisers. Removing the appraiser, however, does not remove history. In neighborhoods where decades of discriminatory lending held down sale prices, the comparable sales an AVM draws on already carry that suppressed value. ______ a model that never considers a homeowner's race can still assign systematically lower valuations to homes in predominantly Black neighborhoods, limiting how much those owners can borrow.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 문장은 AVM이 참고하는 비교 매매가에 이미 과거 차별로 억눌린 가치가 담겨 있다는 원인을 제시하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 그 때문에 인종을 고려하지 않는 모델도 흑인 다수 지역 주택을 낮게 평가한다는 결과를 제시하므로 D가 정답이다. A는 뒤 문장의 'never considers ... can still'이라는 양보적 표현에 끌리게 하지만, 앞 문장 내용과 대조되는 것이 아니라 앞 문장에서 그대로 이어지는 내용이므로 틀리다. B는 뒤 문장이 구체적으로 보이지만, 앞 문장의 일반적 주장을 보여주는 한 가지 사례가 아니라 그 주장에서 도출되는 결과이다. C는 두 문장이 서로 다른 대상을 비교하는 것이 아니므로 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank gives a cause: the comparable sales an AVM uses already carry values held down by past discrimination. The sentence after the blank gives the effect of that cause: even a model that ignores race undervalues homes in predominantly Black neighborhoods. That makes D the answer. A may look tempting because of the concessive wording "never considers ... can still," but the second sentence follows directly from the first rather than contradicting it. B doesn't work because the second sentence isn't one example of a general claim; it's a consequence of the previous point. C is wrong because the text isn't contrasting two different things.
